parameters.jsCode:
const order = $json;
const customer = order.customer || {};
const lineItems = Array.isArray(order.line_items) ? order.line_items : [];
const quantity = lineItems.reduce((s, li) => s + (Number(li.quantity) || 0), 0);
const shipping = Number((order.total_shipping_price_set && order.total_shipping_price_set.shop_money && order.total_shipping_price_set.shop_money.amount) || 0);
return [{ json: {
  event_type: 'ORDER',
  execution_id: $execution.id,
  timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
  shopify_order_id: String(order.id || ''),
  order_name: order.name || '',
  order_value: Number(order.total_price || 0),
  subtotal: Number(order.subtotal_price || 0),
  tax: Number(order.total_tax || 0),
  shipping_cost: shipping,
  payment_status: order.financial_status || '',
  fulfillment_status: order.fulfillment_status || 'unfulfilled',
  tracking_number: '',
  order_created_at: order.created_at || '',
  order_updated_at: order.updated_at || '',
  products: lineItems.map(li => li.title).join(', '),
  quantity,
  line_items: lineItems,
  shopify_customer_id: String(customer.id || ''),
  customer_name: [customer.first_name, customer.last_name].filter(Boolean).join(' ').trim(),
  customer_email: customer.email || order.email || '',
  customer_phone: customer.phone || '',
  customer_total_orders: Number(customer.orders_count || 0),
  customer_total_spent: Number(customer.total_spent || 0),
} }];

const p = $json;
const v = (Array.isArray(p.variants) && p.variants[0]) || {};
return [{ json: {
  event_type: 'PRODUCT',
  execution_id: $execution.id,
  timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
  shopify_product_id: String(p.id || ''),
  sku: v.sku || '',
  product_name: p.title || '',
  body_html: p.body_html || '',
  category: p.product_type || '',
  vendor: p.vendor || '',
  tags: p.tags || '',
  shopify_status: p.status || 'draft',
  selling_price: Number(v.price || 0),
  inventory: Number(v.inventory_quantity || 0),
  created_at: p.created_at || '',
  updated_at: p.updated_at || '',
} }];
return [{ json: { event_type: 'INVENTORY', execution_id: $execution.id, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() } }];
return [{ json: { event_type: 'REPORT', execution_id: $execution.id, timestamp: new Date().toISOString(), report_date: new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10) } }];

const src = $('RESEARCH - New Row Trigger').item.json;
let ai = {};
try { const raw = $json.output || '{}'; ai = typeof raw === 'string' ? JSON.parse(raw.replace(/^\`\`\`json|\`\`\`$/g,'').trim()) : raw; } catch (e) { ai = {}; }
return [{ json: {
  execution_id: $execution.id,
  timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
  research_id: src['Research ID'] || ('R-' + $execution.id),
  product_name: src['Product Name'] || '',
  supplier: src.Supplier || '',
  supplier_url: src['Supplier URL'] || '',
  cost: Number(src.Cost || 0),
  estimated_selling_price: Number(src['Estimated Selling Price'] || 0),
  estimated_profit: Number(ai.estimated_profit || 0),
  competition_score: Number(ai.competition_score || 0),
  demand_score: Number(ai.demand_score || 0),
  trend_score: Number(ai.trend_score || 0),
  saturation_score: Number(ai.saturation_score || 0),
  risk_score: Number(ai.risk_score || 0),
  ai_score: Number(ai.ai_score || 0),
  recommendation: ai.recommendation || 'TEST',
  reason: ai.reason || '',
} }];
